# Paper 02: Inventory Buffers vs. Responsiveness

## Abstract

This note compares static inventory buffers with adaptive replenishment rules.
Large static buffers improved short disruptions, but adaptive replenishment
performed better in prolonged demand swings.

## Findings

- Static buffers improved service levels during short transport delays.
- Adaptive replenishment reduced excess inventory in multi-month disruptions.
- Hybrid policies worked best when supported by weekly demand review.

## Keywords

inventory, replenishment, service level, demand volatility
